rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is not practical or workable.

example.english: Making a living on luck alone is too impractical.
example.traditional: 淨係靠運氣搵食，呢個諗法太唔實際喇。
example.jyutping: zing6 hai6 kaau3 wan6 hei3 wan2 sik6 ni1 go3 nam2 faat3 taai3 m4 sat6 zai3 laa3

rows.note: Use this especially for a plan, proposal, or method that cannot realistically be carried out.

example.english: Your plan is impractical if it requires getting so much done in a week.
example.traditional: 你個方案要一個星期內完成咁多嘢，根本唔可行。
example.jyutping: nei5 go3 fong1 on3 jiu3 jat1 go3 sing1 kei4 noi6 jyun4 sing4 gam3 do1 je5 gan1 bun2 m4 ho2 hang4

rows.note: Use this for an object or feature that is not useful or convenient in practice.

example.english: This umbrella is really impractical in heavy rain.
example.traditional: 呢把傘咁細，落大雨嗰陣真係唔實用。
example.jyutping: ne1 baa2 saan3 gam3 sai3 lok6 daai6 jyu5 go2 zan6 zan1 hai6 m4 sat6 jung6
